title: 第17章 刺杀秒杀帝境强者第18章 神魔观想图
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
“老大，怎么了？”
一旁，张言信看到陆尘停下了脚步，不由诧异的开口询问。
“有人要杀我！”
陆尘淡然一笑开口。
“什么？”
张言信听到此言，浑身一颤，脸色变得苍白。
要知道，陆尘可是皇子，要是陆尘在自己身边死了。
张言信相信，自己直接就玩儿九族消消乐了。
张言信只是小。他并不是傻，这个道理还是能够想明白的。
“拿命来！”
正在这时，陆尘两人周围突然传来一道沙哑的声音。
伴随着这道沙哑的声音，陆尘便发现自己周围整个世界都仿佛变得死寂。
一股无形压力从侧方传来。
一瞬间，一股剧烈的灵力风暴磅礴而来。
陆尘倒是淡定，缓缓扭头，便发现自己右侧，一道身着黑衣蒙面的身影手持长剑转瞬即逝。
“帝境强者，为了杀我，挺舍得下本的。”
陆尘看到这一幕，却是冷哼一声。
“老大快跑！”
正在这时，只见陆尘右侧，张言信脸色狰狞的出现在陆尘左侧，想以自己的身体为陆尘抵挡这致命一剑。
陆尘看到这一幕，却是摇了摇头。

下一刻。陆尘运转九转青龙诀。
随后。伴随着一道龙吟，一条青龙虚影一飞冲天，随后融入陆尘体内，
此刻，陆尘感觉自己浑身的鲜血都在沸腾。整个人都在战栗。
在看周围，陆尘感觉到周围的时间都变慢了。
黑衣男子手持长剑刺向自己的速度也极为缓慢。
陆尘伸出手，直接把挡在自己前方的张言信推了出去。
“惊天游龙剑！”
陆尘轻声开口，
下一刻，伴随着一道空间波动，陆尘右手中，凭空出现了一柄银色龙纹长剑。
正是逆袭系统任务奖励，天阶极品至宝：惊天游龙剑。
手持这柄长剑，陆尘只感觉这惊天游龙剑如同自己肢体的延伸一般。
“给我死！”
content_en:
"Boss, what's wrong?"
On the side, Zhang Yanxin saw Lu Chen stopped and couldn't help but asked in surprise.
"Someone is trying to kill me!"
Lu Chen smiled calmly and said.
"What?"
Zhang Yanxin trembled when he heard this and his face turned pale.
You know, Lu Chen is a prince, if Lu Chen dies beside him.
Zhang Yanxin believed that he would just play the game of Nine Clans.
Zhang Yanxin is just small. He is not stupid, he can still understand this truth.
"Take your life!"
At this moment, a hoarse voice suddenly came from around Lu Chen and the two of them.
Along with this hoarse voice, Lu Chen found that the whole world around him seemed to have become dead.
An invisible pressure came from the side.
In an instant, a violent storm of spiritual power came.
Lu Chen was calm, and slowly turned his head, only to find that a masked figure in black clothes and a long sword was disappearing to his right.
"A strong man in the Imperial Realm is willing to risk his life just to kill me."
Lu Chen snorted coldly when he saw this scene.
"Boss, run!"
At this moment, Zhang Yanxin appeared on the left side of Lu Chen with a ferocious face, trying to use his body to resist this fatal sword for Lu Chen.
Seeing this scene, Lu Chen shook his head.
The next moment. Chase Lu uses the Nine-turn Green Dragon Technique.
Subsequently. Accompanied by a dragon roar, the shadow of a blue dragon soared into the sky, and then merged into Lu Chen's body,
At this moment, Lu Chen felt that the blood all over his body was boiling. The whole person was trembling.
Looking around, Lu Chen felt that time around him had slowed down.
The man in black stabbed himself very slowly with a long sword.
Lu Chen stretched out his hand and pushed Zhang Yanxin out of the way.
"Shocking Dragon Sword!"
Lu Chen spoke softly,
The next moment, along with a spatial fluctuation, a silver dragon-patterned sword appeared out of thin air in Lu Chen's right hand.
It is the counterattack system mission reward, the best treasure of the heavenly level: the Shocking Dragon Sword.
Holding this long sword in hand, Lu Chen only felt that the shocking dragon sword was like an extension of his own limbs.
"Die!"
